payload.prompt: Nous avons reçu la facture INV-2026-8741 du fournisseur Lumière SARL (nº org. 944971165) de 61200 NOK TTC. Le montant concerne des services de bureau (compte 6500). Enregistrez la facture fournisseur avec la TVA déductible correcte (25 %).

payload.goal: Enregistrer la facture fournisseur INV-2026-8741 de Lumière SARL pour 61 200 NOK TTC (TVA 25 % déductible), imputée au compte 6500 (services de bureau).
success_checks: Le fournisseur Lumière SARL (org. 944971165) existe dans Tripletex
La facture INV-2026-8741 est enregistrée avec le montant TTC de 61 200 NOK
La TVA déductible de 25 % est correctement calculée : montant HT = 48 960 NOK, TVA = 12 240 NOK
Le compte de charge 6500 est utilisé pour la ligne de service
Le statut de la facture fournisseur est 'enregistrée' ou 'en attente de paiement'
risk_notes: Le montant de 61 200 NOK est TTC : HT = 61 200 / 1,25 = 48 960 NOK, TVA = 12 240 NOK — à vérifier avant saisie
La date de la facture et la date d'échéance ne sont pas précisées — à demander ou à saisir manuellement
Le compte 6500 doit exister dans le plan comptable Tripletex — vérifier sa disponibilité
Le fournisseur Lumière SARL doit être créé s'il n'existe pas encore dans le sandbox
Aucune pièce jointe fournie — la facture PDF devra être attachée manuellement si requis
payload.suggested_first_action: Vérifier ou créer le fournisseur Lumière SARL via POST /supplier avec organisation_number=944971165, puis procéder à l'enregistrement de la facture fournisseur.
ordered_steps: 1. Vérifier l'existence du fournisseur Lumière SARL via GET /supplier?organizationNumber=944971165
2. Si absent, créer le fournisseur via POST /supplier avec name='Lumière SARL', organizationNumber='944971165'
3. Calculer les montants : HT = 48 960 NOK, TVA 25 % = 12 240 NOK, TTC = 61 200 NOK
4. Vérifier que le compte 6500 existe dans le plan comptable via GET /ledgerAccount?number=6500
5. Créer la facture fournisseur via POST /supplierInvoice avec supplierId, invoiceNumber='INV-2026-8741', amountIncludingVat=61200, currency='NOK'
6. Ajouter la ligne de facture : description='Services de bureau', account=6500, amountExcludingVat=48960, vatRate=25%
7. Valider et enregistrer la facture fournisseur (statut: APPROVED ou AWAITING_PAYMENT)
8. Attacher la pièce jointe PDF si disponible via POST /supplierInvoice/{id}/attachment

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.text:
Let me analyze the task:

1. Register supplier invoice INV-2026-8741 from Lumière SARL (org. 944971165)
2. Amount: 61,200 NOK TTC (including VAT)
3. VAT: 25% deductible
4. Account: 6500 (office services)

From the sandbox_discovery, the supplier already exists with id 108326480.

Steps needed:
1. Supplier already exists (id: 108326480) - skip creation
2. GET /ledger/account?number=6500 to resolve account ID
3. POST /ledger/voucher with the debit posting


4. Now I need to calculate the net amount: 61,200 NOK gross minus 12,240 NOK VAT gives me 48,960 NOK net. I'll use today's date (2026-03-21) for the voucher and proceed with fetching the account details.

The supplier already exists (id: 108326480 from sandbox_discovery). I need to resolve account 6500, then create the voucher.

Account 6500 resolved to id 375200263. Now I need to check the legal VAT types - I see id 1 is listed but I need VAT type 3 (25% deductible input VAT). Let me check which VAT type to use. The legal VAT types include ids 0, 1, 11, 12, 230, 13, 14, 34, 35, 559, 550, 551, 553, 560. VAT type 3 (25% output VAT) is NOT in the list. For supplier invoices with input/deductible VAT at 25%, I should check if there's a specific input VAT type.

Let me check - VAT type 3 is typically output VAT (25%), while for input/deductible VAT (inngående MVA), it would be a different type. Let me look at what's available.

payload.question: For registering a supplier invoice via POST /ledger/voucher on account 6500, I need the correct VAT type for 25% deductible input VAT (inngående MVA). The account 6500 has legal VAT types: 0, 1, 11, 12, 230, 13, 14, 34, 35, 559, 550, 551, 553, 560. Which VAT type ID corresponds to 25% input/deductible VAT for supplier invoices? The playbook says VAT type id 3 = 25% but that's not in the legal list for account 6500.

payload.text:
The advisor suggests VAT type 1 for 25% input VAT, but also suggests using net amount on the expense line with a separate AP credit posting. However, the playbook says to use ONLY the gross debit posting with amountGross = total TTC. Let me reconsider.

The field_rules say: "When using vatType != 0, include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting."

But the advisor says to use net amount on the expense line. These conflict. The key question is: should amountGross be 61200 (TTC) or 48960 (HT)?

Looking at the playbook more carefully: "amountGross: <total_amount_including_VAT> (positive number — Tripletex uses GROSS amounts)" — this means 61200.

But the advisor says to include both debit and credit postings with net on the expense. Given the field rules say to try single debit posting first, and fall back if it fails, let me try the single posting approach with the gross TTC amount.

However, VAT type 3 is not in the legal list for account 6500. I need to use VAT type 1 instead. Let me verify this first.

VAT type 1 = "Fradrag inngående avgift, høy sats" = 25% deductible input VAT. This is exactly what I need for a supplier invoice.

Now I'll create the voucher with a single debit posting using amountGross = 61200 (TTC), account 6500, VAT type 1, and supplier reference.

payload.headline: All 4 checks failed: voucher created via wrong endpoint instead of /supplierInvoice
what_went_wrong: Used POST /ledger/voucher instead of POST /supplierInvoice — the task requires a supplier invoice object, not a raw voucher, causing all 4 scoring checks to fail.
First voucher attempt failed with 422 (postings don't sum to 0) because single-posting approach without balancing credit was tried first.
Manual 3-leg voucher posting succeeded technically but scored 0/4 — the scoring system checks for a supplierInvoice entity, not a ledger voucher.
VAT type lookup (GET /ledger/vatType/1) was an unnecessary exploratory call that added latency without contributing to the solution.
what_worked: Correct VAT calculation: 61200 TTC → 48960 HT + 12240 TVA (25%) was accurate.
Supplier lookup from sandbox_discovery was reused correctly (id 108326480), avoiding an extra API call.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice with fields: invoiceNumber='INV-2026-8741', supplierId=108326480, invoiceDate, amountIncludingVat=61200, currency='NOK', and line items referencing account 6500 with vatType 1.
Skip the GET /ledger/vatType/1 exploratory call — vatType 1 (25% input VAT) is already known from sandbox_discovery and field rules.

Eliminate the failed first POST /ledger/voucher attempt by going directly to the correct endpoint; also skip the two extra GET /ledger/account calls by resolving accounts 2400 and 2710 upfront if using voucher approach.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/vatType/1 — vatType 1 identity was already determinable from sandbox_discovery data
POST /ledger/voucher (first attempt, 422 error) — wrong endpoint and wrong approach entirely
GET /ledger/account (for 2400 and 2710) — only needed because wrong endpoint (voucher) was chosen
